about: Chuzzle is popcap's match-3 variant where the board is filled with googly-eyed fuzzballs that slide in whole rows rather than swap in pairs. Locks, super chuzzles and cascades give it a physics-y puzzle rhythm distinct from bejeweled, and the modes split into classic, speed, zen and puzzles - the last being hand-laid brainteasers rather than endless boards.

Popcap shipped the deluxe windows build in 2006, and it still sits on steam under the popcap label with a live price - one of the surviving popcap originals that never fell out of the store. The page stays in the official-route lane.
It is a 2006 casual 2d at the bottom of the requirements ladder - the target bar is a formality here. The honest state: not-tested until a run confirms install and saves.
